reason_for_recapture: The immediately-prior capture at ea8c0355280d1904b8aae47f19323c253c45e8e7 (posted as artifacts under music-dj-tools/pr-3676/ea8c0355-*, not yet posted as a PR comment) was taken while CI was red for reasons unrelated to Trackify: the branch was 38 commits behind origin/main, which had since landed unrelated trunk-repair fixes (KPI-map-drift, DDL-classification, rb_assets tests). The branch was rebased onto fresh origin/main to pick those fixes up, moving the head to 1dccc53967272b4e0df1d88cd361836ecd79f8f3. The rebase itself touched no Trackify-specific source with real content changes (a JSON KPI-card-declarations merge conflict, a test-durations ledger merge, a one-line optional-field type annotation in performance-ipc.svelte.ts with zero runtime effect), but it DID pull in real changes to the shared boot path that /music-player depends on: apps/webui/frontend/src/routes/+layout.svelte (184 lines), a new apps/webui/frontend/src/lib/rb/feedback-pin-shell-boot.ts deferred-boot-task module, and changes to toast-presentation.ts, toast-report.ts, and stores.svelte.ts. Per this repo's Issue feature evidence release contract, evidence is not tree-equivalent across a shared-boot-path change and must be recaptured at the new head.

comparison_baseline.note: Chosen as the comparison baseline (not the older, already-posted 9e621466ebd7df5c00ce9978294d22542d814b18 comment) because it is the evidence set that immediately precedes this rebase and therefore isolates exactly what the rebase's boot-path pull changed.

known_pre_existing_gap_not_caused_by_thi: The HTTP 500s that drive the skip chain trace to apps/webui/server/rb_vendor_pkg/track_rows.py's bulk_rb_meta querying c.ImagePath, a column scripts/redteam_fixture_library.py's synthetic master.plain.db does not create. This is the same pre-existing fixture-schema gap the earlier FEATURE EVIDENCE comment (head 9e621466) and the immediately-prior ea8c0355 capture both already identified as a non-blocking follow-up; it reproduced identically here. Nothing in the rebase (which touched only shared-boot and metadata files, not track_rows.py or redteam_fixture_library.py) could plausibly change this.

boot_path_regression_check.question: Did the rebase's pulled-in shared-boot-path changes (+layout.svelte 184 lines, new feedback-pin-shell-boot.ts, toast-presentation.ts, toast-report.ts, stores.svelte.ts) introduce any NEW boot-time anomaly on /music-player?
boot_path_regression_check.method: Direct visual + byte comparison of the cold-boot screenshot against the immediately-prior ea8c0355 capture's own cold-boot screenshot (music-dj-tools/pr-3676/ea8c0355-01-cold-empty-state.png), both taken with the same fixture-library setup and the same flow, before any e2e priming.
boot_path_regression_check.finding: IDENTICAL. Both 1dccc539-01-cold-boot-state.png and ea8c0355-01-cold-empty-state.png show the exact same 'Trackify: could not load the feed (HTTP_500: Internal Server Error)' toast, same layout, same copy, same dismiss/copy affordances. This toast is caused by the pre-existing fixture-schema gap above (Trackify's own installTrackifyFeed() hydrate hitting GET /api/v1/tracks?limit=500, which 500s because the fixture library's vendor-mapped rows are missing an ImagePath column), not by anything the rebase pulled in. The mechanism that fires this call at boot (boot-scheduler.ts's deferred idle-triggered burst) itself predates the rebase by three weeks (introduced 2026-09-01, commit c48bdd76f5a, already on both sides of this rebase).
boot_path_regression_check.verdict: NO REGRESSION. The natural-hydrate error toast is present, byte-for-byte equivalent in content and rendering, at both the pre-rebase (ea8c0355) and post-rebase (1dccc539) heads. The toast pipeline itself (which DID change files in this rebase: toast-presentation.ts, toast-report.ts) rendered correctly in both captures -- same text, same styling, same dismiss (x) and click-to-copy affordances -- so the changed toast plumbing is not implicated either.
boot_path_regression_check.additional_confirmation: The same class of 500 (RbApiError, api-rb.ts:266) was also observed firing independently after navigating away from /music-player, confirming the underlying gap is a generic backend/fixture-data issue reachable from any track-listing surface in the app, not something specific to the Trackify boot path.

unattributed_404_from_prior_capture_now_: The ea8c0355 manifest flagged one unattributed 'Failed to load resource: 404' line per run and guessed it was a benign browser default (e.g. favicon.ico), noting it was not independently confirmed via network trace. This capture DID keep a full network request log (1dccc539-capture-log.json) and resolves it: the 404 is `GET /api/v1/tracks/t-fixture-0005/beatgrid-fallback`, fired once the landed track (the unmapped fixture, no vendor row at all) is queried for a beatgrid fallback that does not exist for it. This is expected/benign for an unmapped fixture track, not a Trackify or boot-path defect, and not the favicon guess in the prior manifest.
